title: Shared Provider Test Infrastructure
description:
Build shared stub server test utility in internal/ai/testutil/stubserver/ used by all three provider test harnesses.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Plan references:
- 02-provider-anthropic-test-harness.md §2 (stub server architecture)
- 03-provider-openai-test-harness.md §2
- 04-provider-google-test-harness.md §2

Key deliverables:
- Configurable HTTP test server serving SSE fixtures over real HTTP connections
- Correctness replay mode: serve recorded SSE fixture transcripts
- Fault injection modes: TCP reset (F1), malformed SSE payload (F2), HTTP 429 throttling (F3), slow-consumer backpressure (F4), context cancellation race (F5), non-2xx empty body (F6)
- Request capture for format verification (oracle tests)
- Provider-agnostic design: fixture format works for Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google SSE formats
- Unit tests for the stub server itself
- Tests pass with -race flag

Depends on: Batch 1 AI Core (aiag-qkh)
